title: HtmlTitle
responsibility: Renders the native title element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTitle.attributes
inputs.description: Native title attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTitle.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native title element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTitle
outputs.description: The actual native title element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
